observation_indicators.observable_fil: Tama ang limang hazard-control pair; pinipili ang pause at escalation kung kulang ang mahalagang proteksyon; hindi gumagamit ng ordinaryong basurahan o reuse para sa sharps.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Matches all five hazard-control pairs, pauses and escalates when essential protection is missing, and does not use ordinary bins or reuse for sharps.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Nagmumungkahi ng recapping, pagsiksik, ordinaryong basurahan o pagpapatuloy nang walang mahalagang proteksyon.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Suggests recapping, compression, ordinary bins or continuing without essential protection.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Tama ang limang hazard-control pair; pinipili ang pause at escalation kung kulang ang mahalagang proteksyon; hindi gumagamit ng ordinaryong basurahan o reuse para sa sharps. Nagagawa kahit hindi pinapaalalahanan.
levels.kaya_na_en: Matches all five hazard-control pairs, pauses and escalates when essential protection is missing, and does not use ordinary bins or reuse for sharps. Completes this without prompting.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Ligtas ang desisyon ngunit nalilito ang control para sa dalawang hazard; ipares muli at ipaliwanag ang dahilan.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Makes a safe decision but mixes up controls for two hazards; rematch and explain.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Nagmumungkahi ng recapping, pagsiksik, ordinaryong basurahan o pagpapatuloy nang walang mahalagang proteksyon.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Suggests recapping, compression, ordinary bins or continuing without essential protection.
